scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a solid job of investigating the build failure. It efficiently identified the error (MSB3030), traced it to the configuration mismatch between LrgWindowsFabricHost (Release) and LrgWindowsAppManifest (Debug), and correctly explained why the output file was missing. The main weakness is that it didn't fully enumerate all 41 projects, instead summarizing them. The root cause analysis connecting the missing solution membership to the wrong configuration to the wrong output path was excellent.
scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
